Title: A rep outside the manager's team is not returned
Expected result: HTTP 404 "Rep not found on your team"

Title: A rep on the team can be read by its manager
Preconditions: Business Agent whose team includes the staging Business Sales Agent
Steps: 1. GET `/manager/api/team` 2. take the first rep id 3. GET `/manager/api/rep/{id}`
Expected result: HTTP 200 with `rep` for a team member
